title: WHAT A DEBUT #alliedaniel #hadestown #hadestownwestend #hadestownlond...
transcript: For the one and raise a cup and spill a drop for Ophelia. Our praise is not for them, but the ones who sing. Our praise is not for them, but the ones who blew. We raise our cups to them. We raise our cups and drink them up. We raise them high and drink them dry. To obvious. Good night, brothers! Good night! Whoo! Whoo! 아
